title: Naval intelligence commander's email: UAP enter and leave the ocean in five to seven areas

tellings.quote: these objects all the we see them in the ocean more than more than elsewhere coming in and out of the ocean and they seem to be occurring in five to seven areas of the world.
Undersea bases possibly, right? We know five to seven locations.
tellings.difference: Calls the locations possible undersea bases rather than areas where objects enter and leave the water.
tellings.link_reason: The five to seven ocean locations come from the naval intelligence email about UAP entering and leaving the ocean in five to seven areas.

as_told.title: Five to seven known undersea base locations

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an email he says came from a Navy intelligence commander on a restricted, secret network. According to Gallaudet, the email said these unidentified objects are seen in the ocean more than anywhere else, going in and out of the water, in five to seven areas of the world. Elsewhere in the same talk he calls those locations possible undersea bases, which would mean something is living or working beneath the sea.
